spans.s:
kṛkala
(‘pertaining to the throat’)
------------------------------------------
The human system, according to the treatises on the Vedānta, works with the help of five major prāṇas (pañcaprāṇas, five vital airs) and five minor ones which are subsidiaries of the major prāṇas (hence called upaprāṇas).
Kṛkala is one of the five upaprāṇas, said to be an aspect of समान (one of the five major prāṇas). It is responsible for the act of sneezing.
